body: Boeing rolled the first 737 MAX 10 out of its new North Line at the Everett facility on October 26, and the aircraft is destined for launch customer WestJet. It is the first time a 737 variant has been assembled outside Boeing's historic Renton plant since 1970. The 737 MAX 10's fuselage measures 143 feet, 8 inches (43.8 meters), and Renton's compact assembly bays forced Boeing to stagger the elongated airframe between smaller variants like the MAX 8 to prevent structural overlap between adjacent stations. By repurposing space in Everett's massive widebody plant, Boeing has given its largest narrowbody an assembly line tailored to its length.

Boeing's Renton factory covers roughly 1.1 million sq feet (102,000 m²) of total floor space, with three active assembly lines bounded by Lake Washington and local rail lines. A standard 737 MAX 8 measures 129 feet, 6 inches (39.5 meters) long, while the MAX 10 is stretched 14 feet, 2 inches (4.3 m) longer, so its nose and tail sections intrude into overhead crane pathways and the working envelopes of adjacent stations. To avoid costly structural collisions during station transitions, Renton line managers must manually stagger the build sequence so a longer MAX 10 is always preceded and followed by shorter MAX 7 or MAX 8 airframes. The requirement creates scheduling friction across Renton's 12,000-person workforce, and with 1,555 firm orders for the MAX 10, about 31% of the total 737 MAX backlog, Renton's layout threatened to become a permanent operational bottleneck.

Boeing began a $1 billion capital project to establish the 737 MAX North Line inside its flagship Everett facility, occupying high-bay space in Building 40-22 vacated following the consolidation of 787 Dreamliner assembly to South Carolina. The new line provides approximately 20% more usable floor area per station than Renton, so the 737 MAX 10 can move continuously in a true nose-to-tail orientation without staggered buffers. Supported by an initial workforce of roughly 1,000 employees, about half reassigned directly from Renton, the dedicated layout increases total 737 manufacturing capacity by 25% across Boeing's Puget Sound industrial network. Rollout does not mean deliveries are imminent: the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) granted amended type certification for the 737 MAX 10 flight platform on October 20, 2026, but Boeing must still secure a separate amendment to its FAA Production Certificate, and initial WestJet deliveries will remain paused until it is formally issued.

Boeing leadership confirmed that the main constraint on narrowbody output is an ongoing shortage of wing subassemblies, which are arriving well behind schedule. Boeing revised its master production ramp and now expects to reach and hold 47 aircraft per month in 2027, before attempting a further push toward 52 jets per month later that year. The MAX 10 carries 185 to 210 passengers in a standard two-class layout, with a maximum capacity of 230 seats and a range of 3,100 nautical miles (5,740 km), competing directly with Airbus' A321neo. With firm orders from operators including United Airlines, Delta Air Lines, WestJet and Ryanair, and Lufthansa also opting for the type, Renton can focus its three moving lines on high-volume MAX 8 and MAX 9 builds while Everett takes on the MAX 10.
en.summary: Boeing rolled out the first 737 MAX 10 assembled on its new North Line in Everett on October 26, ending the 737's single-factory history at Renton since 1970; Renton's tight bays forced MAX 10s to be staggered between shorter jets, while Everett can build them nose-to-tail, lifting total 737 capacity by 25%.
en.title: Boeing's Renton Factory Must Stagger The 737 MAX 10 With Smaller Jets, But Everett Can Run Nose-To-Tail

body: 波音10月26日在Everett新設的北產線（North Line）推出首架737MAX10，該機將交付啟動客戶西捷航空（WestJet）；這是自1970年以來，首款不在波音歷史悠久的Renton廠組裝的737機型。737MAX10機身長143呎8吋（43.8公尺），Renton廠房空間狹小，若在當地生產，必須將加長的機身錯置在MAX8等較短機型之間，以免與相鄰工位結構重疊；Everett廠房空間較大，可讓MAX10連續以機頭接機尾的方式移動，不需錯位緩衝。

Renton廠區總樓面面積約110萬平方呎（102,000平方公尺），三條現役組裝線夾在華盛頓湖與鐵路之間，空間緊湊；標準737MAX8機身長129呎6吋（39.5公尺），MAX10比MAX8長14呎2吋（4.3公尺），機頭與機尾會侵入高架吊車通道與相鄰工位的工作範圍，因此產線管理人員必須讓每架MAX10前後都安排較短的MAX7或MAX8。錯位生產限制了排程彈性，Renton廠區人力達12,000人，波音現有1,555架MAX10確認訂單，約占737MAX總積壓訂單的31%，Renton的廠房布局可能成為長期的營運瓶頸。

為解決空間限制，波音投資10億美元，在Everett的40-22號廠房建立北產線，該處是787夢幻客機組裝整併至南卡羅來納州後騰出的高棚空間；新產線每個工位的可用樓面面積比Renton多約20%，並配備現代化工具，初期人力約1,000人，約半數由Renton調任，普吉特灣地區的737總產能因此提升25%。不過，出廠不代表即將交付：美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）雖已於10月20日核發MAX10飛行平台的修訂型別檢定證，波音仍須取得FAA生產檢定證的修訂，FAA須逐站稽核Everett新產線，初期西捷航空的交付將暫緩，直至修訂正式核發。

波音表示，目前窄體機產量的主要限制是機翼次組件短缺，機翼結構抵達組裝廠的速度落後於計畫；波音已修訂增產計畫，預計2027年達到並維持每月47架，之後再朝每月52架邁進。MAX10標準兩艙布局可載185至210名乘客，最多230人，航程3,100海里（5,740公里），與空中巴士A321neo競爭；確認訂單客戶包括聯合航空、達美航空、西捷航空與瑞安航空，漢莎航空亦已選用此機型。未來Renton將專注於MAX8與MAX9的大量生產，Everett則負責MAX10與高密度MAX8。
zh.summary: 波音首架在Everett新北產線組裝的737MAX10於10月26日出廠，終結737系列自1970年以來僅在Renton生產的歷史；Renton廠房空間不足，MAX10須與較短機型錯位生產，Everett產線則可連續組裝，整體737產能提升25%。
zh.title: 波音Everett新產線投產737MAX10，Renton廠不再受限於機身長度
